title: Pricing options on the cryptocurrency futures contracts
abstract: arXiv:2506.14614v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The cryptocurrency options market is notable for its high volatility and lower liquidity compared to traditional markets. These characteristics introduce significant challenges to traditional option pricing methodologies. Addressing these complexities requires advanced models that can effectively capture the dynamics of the market. We explore which option pricing models are most effective in valuing cryptocurrency options. Specifically, we calibrate and evaluate the performance of the Black-Scholes, Merton Jump Diffusion, Variance Gamma, Kou, Heston, and Bates models. Our analysis focuses on pricing vanilla options on futures contracts for Bitcoin (BTC) and Ether (ETH). We find that the Black-Scholes model exhibits the highest pricing errors. translated_title: 加密货币期货合约期权的定价
translated_abstract: 加密货币期权市场以其高波动性和相较于传统市场较低的流动性而著称。这些特征给传统期权定价方法带来了显著挑战。应对这些复杂性需要能够有效捕捉市场动态的先进模型。我们探讨了哪些期权定价模型在估值加密货币期权时最为有效。具体而言，我们校准并评估了Black-Scholes、Merton跳扩散、Variance Gamma、Kou、Heston和Bates模型的表现。我们的分析聚焦于对比特币（BTC）和以太坊（ETH）期货合约上的香草期权进行定价。我们发现Black-Scholes模型表现出最高的定价误差。相比之下，Kou和Bates模型实现了最低误差，其中Kou模型在BTC期权上表现最佳，而Bates模型在ETH期权上表现最佳。结果凸显了考虑跳跃和随机波动性在加密货币期权定价中的重要性。
tldr: 本研究比较了六种期权定价模型在加密货币期货期权上的表现，发现Kou和Bates模型优于传统Black-Scholes模型，分别对BTC和ETH期权产生最低定价误差，强调了跳跃和随机波动性对加密货币市场定价的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This study compares six option pricing models for cryptocurrency futures options, finding that Kou and Bates models outperform the traditional Black-Scholes model, yielding the lowest pricing errors for BTC and ETH options respectively, highlighting the critical role of jumps and stochastic volatility in crypto market pricing.
